claims: Michigan defeated Alabama 90-77 in a 2026 NCAA Tournament Sweet 16 matchup on March 27, 2026.
Michigan advanced to the Elite Eight.
Alabama finished their season with a 25-6 record.
Elliot Cadeau had 16 points and 6 assists for Michigan.
Labaron Philon averaged 21.6 points leading up to the game for Alabama.
The game was at the United Center in Chicago.
